name: wowusky-builtin
description: Curated builtin catalog shipped with wowusky.

addons.name: ElvUI
addons.author: Elv & Simpy
addons.description: Complete UI replacement with unit frames, action bars, nameplates, bags, chat.

addons.name: Tukui
addons.author: Tukz
addons.description: Minimal UI replacement. Lightweight, fast, performant.

addons.name: Shadowed Unit Frames
addons.author: Shadowed / Nevcairiel
addons.description: Lightweight, customizable unit frames. Uses the maintained Nevcairiel repo with Classic/TBC Anniversary packages.

addons.name: Bartender4
addons.author: Nevcairiel
addons.description: Customizable action bars with extensive options. Current upstream is GitHub/WowAce, not the old WoWInterface id.

addons.name: Dominos
addons.author: Tuller
addons.description: Replaces the default action bars with movable, configurable bars.

addons.name: WeakAuras 2
addons.author: WeakAuras Team
addons.description: Powerful framework for visual displays of buffs, cooldowns, mechanics. Wago.io support built-in.

addons.name: WeakAuras Companion
addons.author: wowusky
addons.description: Generates WeakAurasCompanion data from Wago.io subscriptions. Auto-installs.

addons.name: OmniCC
addons.author: Tuller
addons.description: Adds countdown text to ability cooldowns on action buttons.

addons.name: TellMeWhen
addons.author: Cybeloras
addons.description: Customizable icons for cooldown/buff/debuff tracking.

addons.name: Details!
addons.author: Tercio
addons.description: Detailed damage meter with extensive statistics and analysis. CurseForge is used because GitHub releases are outdated.

addons.name: Skada
addons.author: Zarnivoop
addons.description: Modular damage/healing/threat meter. Lightweight alternative to Details!.

addons.name: Recount
addons.author: Resike
addons.description: Classic combat tracker. Uses maintained Resike/Recount repo with Retail, MoP and Classic tags.

addons.name: Omen Threat Meter
addons.author: Omen Team
addons.description: Classic-era threat meter. Open CurseForge/Wago and import the ZIP because current maintained sources vary by flavor.

addons.name: BigWigs
addons.author: BigWigs Team
addons.description: Boss warnings for raids and dungeons. Uses flavor-specific BigWigs repositories where available.

addons.name: LittleWigs
addons.author: BigWigs Team
addons.description: BigWigs for dungeons, delves, and scenarios.

addons.name: Deadly Boss Mods
addons.author: MysticalOS
addons.description: The classic boss mod alternative for Retail.

addons.name: Deadly Boss Mods (Classic)
addons.author: MysticalOS
addons.description: DBM for Classic Era and TBC Anniversary.

addons.name: Plater
addons.author: Tercio
addons.description: Highly customizable nameplates with profiles, scripting, threat display.

addons.name: Kui Nameplates
addons.author: Kesava
addons.description: Clean, customizable nameplates.

addons.name: Threat Plates
addons.author: Backupiseasy
addons.description: Threat-coloured nameplates for tanks and dps. Uses the maintained Backupiseasy/ThreatPlates repo.

addons.name: Questie
addons.author: Questie Team
addons.description: Quest helper for Classic/TBC – objectives on map and minimap.

addons.name: Quest Guru
addons.author: QuestGuruTeam
addons.description: Enhanced quest log and tracker.

addons.name: Leatrix Plus
addons.author: Leatrix
addons.description: Quality of life modifications: auto-quest, faster looting, and more. CurseForge is used because the project supports all current WoW flavors there.

addons.name: Bagnon
addons.author: Jaliborc
addons.description: Single-window inventory replacement. Uses current Jaliborc/Bagnon upstream.

addons.name: ArkInventory
addons.author: Arkayenro
addons.description: Highly configurable inventory with auto-sorting and rules.

addons.name: Auctionator
addons.author: Auctionator Team
addons.description: Improved Auction House interface with price scanning.

addons.name: TradeSkillMaster
addons.author: TSM Team
addons.description: Advanced auction house and crafting automation.

addons.name: GatherMate2
addons.author: Nevcairiel
addons.description: Map markers for herbs, mining nodes, treasures, and gathered items.

addons.name: Gatherer
addons.author: Esamynn
addons.description: Classic gathering profession tracker.

addons.name: Mapster
addons.author: Nevcairiel
addons.description: Lightweight world map enhancements.

addons.name: Carbonite Maps
addons.author: Rythal
addons.description: Comprehensive map replacement with quest tracking.

addons.name: Gladius
addons.author: Knall
addons.description: Arena enemy unit frames.

addons.name: Gladdy
addons.author: Knall
addons.description: Classic-style arena unit frames.

addons.name: Trinket Menu
addons.author: Charva
addons.description: Quick trinket swap menu.

addons.name: Pawn
addons.author: Vger
addons.description: Item comparison and upgrade scoring.

addons.name: RareScanner
addons.author: Niclasco
addons.description: Alerts when rare creatures are nearby.

addons.name: Move Any
addons.author: TheGenericHero
addons.description: Move and resize default UI panels.

addons.name: AtlasLoot Classic
addons.author: Hegarol
addons.description: Browse dungeon/raid loot tables.

addons.name: Prat
addons.author: Krtek
addons.description: Customizable chat enhancements.

addons.name: WIM
addons.author: Maul
addons.description: WoW Instant Messenger – tabbed chat windows.

addons.name: Ace3
addons.author: Ace3 Team
addons.description: Library framework used by many addons. Install if missing.

addons.name: LibSharedMedia-3.0
addons.author: Elkano
addons.description: Provides fonts, textures, sounds for other addons.
